Privacy & cookies

Updated 22 October 2026 · Lions marketing website

This notice covers the Lions Barbers information website. For enquiries about this website or your information, contact Lions Barbers at 2 Mint Walk, Croydon, CR0 1EA, or through the Instagram and Facebook profiles linked below. IntAillium is credited as the website creator; that credit is not a booking or data-consent form.

Browsing this website

This website has no customer account, booking form or payment form. Its hosting service receives technical information needed to serve and protect pages, such as IP address, request time and browser information. This supports our legitimate interest in operating a reliable, secure website. Hosting and security records are managed under the hosting provider’s retention and security arrangements.

Bookings and messages

Choosing a booking link opens Barber Dresser on a separate domain. Service links may include a public service identifier, but this website does not put your name, contact details or payment information in those links. Account, booking, payment and optional location information are handled by the booking platform; review its notices and consent choices before providing them.

If you message Lions on Instagram or Facebook, your message is handled through that service and by the shop to respond to your enquiry. Do not send payment details or sensitive information through social messages.

Cookies & external content

The marketing site does not add advertising or analytics scripts, or set its own tracking cookies. The hosting service may use cookies needed for access or security. Fonts load from Google Fonts and some editorial photographs load from Unsplash, so those providers receive connection information when their resources load.

The Spotify player loads only when you choose to open the shop soundtrack. Loading it connects to Spotify, which may use cookies or other storage under its own policies. You can browse without opening the player. Closing the panel hides it; reload the page without opening the panel to stop using the embedded player. Manage existing cookies in your browser settings.

External map and social links open the named provider. Read their privacy information before using them: Spotify, Google, Unsplash and Meta. Providers may process connection data outside the UK under their own arrangements.

Your choices and rights

Depending on the circumstances, you can request access to, correction or deletion of your personal information, restrict or object to its use, and request portability. You may withdraw consent where processing relies on consent. Contact Lions through the routes above and explain your request. You can also raise a concern with the Information Commissioner’s Office.

This notice describes the marketing website. It does not replace the booking platform’s notice or the shop’s information about records kept for services delivered in person.
